impact: A strong open would ease pressure on AI holdings (GOOGL, MSFT, NBIS, MU, PLTR) after the five-day slide, but premarket moves can fade as Wednesday's Nvidia bounce did.
summary: US stock futures rose Thursday morning as investors awaited Anthropic's Nasdaq debut as ANT after it priced at $83. At about 9:09 UTC, Dow futures were up about 0.6%, S&P 500 futures about 1% and Nasdaq-100 futures about 2%, after the S&P 500's fifth straight loss on Wednesday. Walmart reports before the open.
title: Nasdaq futures up 2%, S&P up 1% ahead of Anthropic's debut
